activity.notes: Representative year for the 1956 first voyage of McLean's modern container-shipping system; this records his central role in commercializing standardized intermodal container transport rather than claiming he invented every precursor technology.

sources.title: How Containers Changed the World — Smithsonian Ocean
sources.citation_text: The Smithsonian traces modern container shipping to Malcom McLean's 1956 commercial system and its subsequent transformation of global freight transport.
